bls-nutrition-per-dollar-latest.name: BLS Nutrition per Dollar: Federal Food Prices by Region, Refreshed Monthly
bls-nutrition-per-dollar-latest.title: BLS Nutrition per Dollar, Latest Month by Region
bls-nutrition-per-dollar-latest.description: Protein and fiber per dollar for the BLS Average Price food items that carry a defensible USDA match, at the latest published month, for the US city average and the four census regions. Rebuilt from the BLS public API every month, so it is a live series rather than a one-retailer snapshot.
bls-nutrition-per-dollar-latest.long_description: Protein and fiber per US dollar for every BLS Average Price food item that has a defensible USDA FoodData Central match, at the most recent month BLS has published, for the U.S. city average and the four census regions. Prices are not a shelf snapshot from one retailer: they are the federal Average Price survey, and this file is rebuilt from the BLS public API every month. Each row carries the price, the grams in the priced unit, the edible fraction, the resulting price per 100 grams of edible food, and the USDA record ID, so any number in it can be recomputed from the row itself. Items whose priced unit cannot be converted to grams from a citable source, and items where the BLS category spans USDA records that disagree materially, are left out on purpose and listed with reasons in pipeline-data/bls/bls-food-nutrient-map.json.

schema.name: bls_series_id
schema.description: BLS Average Price series ID, built as AP + U + area_code + bls_item_code. Query it directly at api.bls.gov to reproduce the price.

schema.name: bls_item_code
schema.description: BLS item code, the last six characters of the series ID. Alphanumeric: the post-2018 items begin with letters, for example FS1101 for stick butter.

schema.name: bls_item_name
schema.description: BLS item name, verbatim, including the priced unit. The unit is part of the item definition and is what grams_per_priced_unit converts.

schema.name: area_code
schema.description: BLS area code as a zero-padded string. 0000 is the U.S. city average; 0100, 0200, 0300 and 0400 are the Northeast, Midwest, South and West census regions.

schema.name: area_name
schema.description: Human-readable area name for area_code, from the BLS AP area file.

schema.name: year
schema.description: Calendar year of the price observation.

schema.name: period
schema.description: BLS period code for the observation month, M01 through M12. The M13 annual average is excluded, because this is a monthly file.

schema.name: date
schema.description: First day of the observation month in ISO 8601 form, so the series can be charted on a time axis without reparsing year and period.

schema.name: price_usd
schema.description: BLS published average price in US dollars for ONE priced unit of the item, meaning one pound, one dozen or one gallon as the item name states.

schema.name: grams_per_priced_unit
schema.description: Gross grams of product in that priced unit, before refuse is removed. Taken from the BLS unit string where it states the grams, and otherwise derived from the USDA record's own published portion weights.

schema.name: edible_fraction
schema.description: Share of grams_per_priced_unit that is edible food. 1.0 where there is no refuse. Below 1.0 only where the USDA record itself publishes the yield.

schema.name: edible_grams_per_priced_unit
schema.description: grams_per_priced_unit multiplied by edible_fraction: the grams of edible food a shopper gets for price_usd.

schema.name: price_per_100g_usd
schema.description: 100 x price_usd / edible_grams_per_priced_unit. US dollars per 100 grams of edible food, which is what makes items priced per pound, per dozen and per gallon comparable to each other.

schema.name: fdc_id
schema.description: USDA FoodData Central record ID supplying the nutrient values for this item. Records are SR Legacy unless the map says otherwise.

schema.name: fdc_description
schema.description: USDA record description, verbatim, so the food identity behind the numbers can be checked without opening FoodData Central.

schema.name: protein_g_per_100g
schema.description: Grams of protein per 100 grams of edible food, from the USDA record named in fdc_id.

schema.name: fiber_g_per_100g
schema.description: Grams of dietary fiber per 100 grams of edible food, from the USDA record named in fdc_id. A published 0.0 for meat and dairy is a measured value, not a missing one.

schema.name: protein_g_per_dollar
schema.description: protein_g_per_100g divided by price_per_100g_usd. The edible fraction is already inside price_per_100g_usd and must not be applied a second time.

schema.name: fiber_g_per_dollar
schema.description: fiber_g_per_100g divided by price_per_100g_usd. The edible fraction is already inside price_per_100g_usd and must not be applied a second time.

schema.name: value_source
schema.description: Where the nutrient values came from: a full-precision value already audited in a Daily Life Hacks flagship CSV, or the USDA portal endpoint, which rounds to three significant figures.

protein-quality-per-dollar-2026.name: Protein per Dollar Adjusted for Quality (DIAAS): 25 Foods (2026)
protein-quality-per-dollar-2026.title: Protein per Dollar Adjusted for Quality, DIAAS (2026)
protein-quality-per-dollar-2026.description: Twenty-five protein foods re-ranked after adjusting protein per dollar by DIAAS digestibility scores, with the source and method behind every score.
protein-quality-per-dollar-2026.long_description: 25 protein sources whose raw protein-per-dollar figure is multiplied by a published DIAAS digestibility score, capped at 1.00, to give usable protein per dollar. Every DIAAS value names the peer-reviewed measurement it came from.

schema.description: Food item as sold at retail, including the form (dry, canned, frozen, bone-in) where the form changes the math.

schema.name: diaas_source

schema.name: adjusted_g_per_dollar

schema.name: notes
